configuration:
dfs.default.blocksize 536870912
dfs.blocksize 512m
dfs.namenode.http-bind-host 0.0.0.0
dfs.namenode.rpc-bind-host 0.0.0.0
dfs.namenode.servicerpc-bind-host 0.0.0.0
dfs.replication 3
dfs.namenode.name.dir.ftxz-hadoop /hdfs_data/namenode/name

dfs.namenode.replication.max-streams 8

dfs.namenode.support.allow.format false

dfs.datanode.peer.stats.enabled true

dfs.domain.socket.path /var/run/hadoop/dn_socket

dfs.datanode.failed.volumes.tolerated -1
